Senior Software Engineer Full-Time | Permanent Location New York, NY, United States Work Environment In-person

Compensation $175,000 – $200,000 per year

Schedule Monday – Friday, Eastern Time business hours

Do you use Ruby everyday? Like building something from the ground up? Equity Opportunity?

About the Opportunity We are a modern technology and services company transforming how organizations source, employ, and manage contract workers. Our goal is to provide a turnkey, full-stack software and service experience for an industry traditionally dominated by manual, cumbersome processes. We are a growing organization with an experienced engineering team and a production platform serving real customers every day. Our customers include fast-growing technology companies and innovative organizations operating in areas such as autonomous vehicles, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technologies. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Feature Team as we continue scaling delivery capacity across our core platform. This role is ideal for an experienced senior engineer who can quickly understand business context, collaborate closely with product partners, own features end-to-end, and help improve the overall effectiveness of the engineering team. 1 About the Role You'll work on our core staffing and workforce management application—a large, modular Rails codebase operating with real production constraints. Work often begins as loosely defined problem statements. Senior engineers are expected to bring context to those problems, shape practical solutions, clarify tradeoffs, and deliver changes that are maintainable and easy for future engineers to build upon. You'll sometimes lead initiatives and sometimes work under the direction of another senior engineer. In every situation, you'll be expected to communicate clearly, thoughtfully challenge assumptions when appropriate, and keep delivery moving forward.

What You'll Do

Own large product features end-to-end, from shaping the technical approach through delivery. Break down ambiguous business and technical problems into clear, actionable solutions. Work closely with product partners to clarify requirements and thoughtfully manage scope. Communicate proactively with teammates and leadership regarding delivery expectations and progress. Review code with a strong focus on maintainability and long-term quality—not just correctness. Write and maintain automated tests as a core responsibility. Improve legacy areas of the codebase incrementally and pragmatically. Use AI development tools, such as Copilot and Claude, to improve productivity while maintaining full accountability for the code you ship. Technology Stack

Backend: Ruby on Rails 8.1 Frontend: React 18.3, with some Stimulus and Turbo Datastores: PostgreSQL and Redis Infrastructure: Cloud-based application platform CI/CD: GitHub Actions Architecture: Modular monolith with engineers working across the full stack What Senior-Level Means in This Role A Senior Software Engineer is trusted to:
Own projects from concept through delivery. 2

Coordinate effectively with teammates contributing to the same initiative. Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs without perfect information. Improve team velocity and effectiveness—not just individual output. Senior engineers are not expected to operate on autopilot or wait for detailed instructions. They proactively identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Compared with a mid-level engineer, senior engineers take greater ownership and initiative. Compared with staff-level engineers, the focus is more heavily on execution and team effectiveness than broader organizational or cultural leadership. Production Ownership

On-call responsibilities are very limited. A dedicated on-call engineer handles most production support and escalates issues to the Feature Team when necessary. Expected involvement in production debugging is relatively low. Expectations around testing, maintainability, and code quality are high. Requirements

Significant real-world experience with Ruby on Rails. Experience owning large product features from concept through delivery in a product-focused organization. Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests. Comfortable partnering closely with product managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with remote teammates while remaining highly communicative and proactive. Approximately 8–10 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through technical impact and accomplishments. Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading work involving Stimulus and Turbo. Experience working in entrepreneurial, startup, or early-stage environments. Strong end-to-end testing practices. Experience with ERP-style data modeling or complex business domains. Experience in staffing, HR technology, workforce management, marketplaces, or similar platforms. 3 Interview Process Candidates can expect to:

Read and discuss a small Rails application. Identify meaningful opportunities for improvement. Walk through a previous project in depth and explain—and potentially critique—technical decisions. Be evaluated on clarity, humility, collaboration, judgment, and impact, in addition to technical ability. Benefits The company offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Equity opportunities Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents Life and disability insurance Paid parental leave Work-from-home and home office support Company-provided Apple laptop Phone and internet stipend Flexible/unlimited paid time off, along with paid office holidays 401(k) retirement plan About the Company Our mission is to make it easier for companies to build and manage high-performing contract workforces. Today, many mid-sized organizations managing contract workers must navigate significant legal, financial, talent acquisition, and operational complexities—often relying on multiple disconnected solutions for sourcing talent, employing workers, tracking workforce activity, and managing day-to-day operations. Our platform brings technology and human expertise together to provide organizations with more integrated tools and services for managing contract workforces efficiently and compliantly. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply. This is a full-time, permanent position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who are able to work during Eastern Time Zone business hours. Sponsorship and corp-to-corp arrangements are not available.

Job Title: Lead, Software Engineering (DevSecOps)

Job Code: 44023

Job Location: Colorado Springs, Colorado

Job Schedule: 9/80 - Employees work 9 out of every 14 days - totaling 80 hours worked (Every Other Friday Off)

Job Description:

The National Space Test and Training Complex–Orbital (NSTTC-O) Range Control Software (RCS) program operates a mission-critical platform stack across on-premises OpenStack and Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud within a rigorous Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) and Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance envelope, and is seeking a senior technical leader to guide and strengthen that infrastructure layer. Essential Functions:

Lead platform engineering for the Amazon Web Services GovCloud and OpenStack environment.
Direct the infrastructure work supporting the Region 2 data center migration.
Build and sustain infrastructure automation and deployment workflows.
Establish and maintain delivery pipelines using Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitLab, and related tools.
Develop and maintain infrastructure and configuration automation using Terraform, Ansible, shell scripting, and Python.
Integrate security and compliance considerations into platform operations and delivery.
Coordinate platform-engineering execution and subcontractor delivery.
Travel up to 15% as needed to support program and customer requirements.

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.

Experience designing, deploying, and sustaining Amazon Web Services GovCloud and OpenStack infrastructure.
Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux-based systems in production environments.
Experience deploying, operating, and securing Kubernetes environments.

Amazon Web Services certification, such as Amazon Web Services Certified Solutions Architect or a role-aligned specialty certification.

Red Hat Certified System Administrator or Red Hat Certified Engineer certification.

Experience developing automation or operational tooling using Lua.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Back End PL
jobs.description:
Somos a **Conexa**, ecossistema digital de saúde integral, líder na **América Latina**. Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Nascemos com o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à saúde de qualidade, e acreditamos que corpo e mente precisam ser tratados de forma integrada para que o paciente tenha uma vida saudável. Atualmente, realizamos mais de 400 mil consultas por mês, sendo 180 mil em saúde mental. Com o nosso modelo de negócios, conseguimos cobrir 24 milhões de vidas.

**Temos um time formado por pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e que acreditam em um futuro com mais saúde física e mental para todos!**

**Aviso importante!**

A **Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor** para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas **exclusivamente pela Gupy** e o processo de inscrição é **totalmente gratuito**. Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**

**Principais responsabilidades:**

* Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir sistemas já existentes, com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
* Ter domínio de arquitetura de software e capacidade de propor evoluções estruturais no sistema
* Implementar integrações entre serviços internos e externos (APIs, microsserviços, sistemas distribuídos).
* Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia e padrões definidos pela área.
* Criar e executar testes automatizados e unitários para garantir a qualidade das entregas.
* Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, QA, front end e dados, garantindo a entrega ponta a ponta.
* Participar ativamente de code reviews, contribuindo para o aprendizado coletivo e a manutenção de padrões técnicos.
* Monitorar e otimizar desempenho de aplicações, identificando e resolvendo gargalos.
* Documentar fluxos, arquiteturas e práticas adotadas, fortalecendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
* Colaborar em cerimônias ágeis (plannings, refinamentos, retrospectivas), trazendo postura propositiva e resolutiva.
* Apoiar desenvolvedores juniores.

  
**Requisitos e qualificações**

**Requisitos**

* Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento back end em Java.
* Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB).
* Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e queries complexas/pesadas.
* Conhecimento em arquitetura de serviços modulares e APIs RESTful.
* Experiência com testes automatizados, versionamento (Git) e CI/CD.
* Conhecimento em ferramentas de IA para geração de código (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, entre outras).
* Atuação prévia em times de produto digital e metodologias ágeis.
* Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas complexos, com boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

**Diferenciais**

* Experiência em **healthtechs** ou empresas de grande complexidade técnica.
* Vivência com **AWS** (EC2, RDS, SQS, Beanstalk).
* Experiência prévia no desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando ferramentas de IA (Claude, Cursor, Codex, etc).
* Experiência em **observabilidade, monitoramento e boas práticas de SRE**.
* Atuação prévia em ambientes de **escala e alto volume de dados**.

**Benefícios Conexa:**

**Cartão** **CAJU**, crédito de R$ 1.059,00 ao mês distribuídos entre as categorias: Refeição, Alimentação, Mobilidade, Saúde, Home Office, Cultura e Educação;

* Experiência em projetos que envolvem sistemas regulados e auditáveis

* Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil

**A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:**

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer – Quality & Test Automation [Remoto - Brasil]
jobs.description:
A **DBServices** é uma empresa que possui raízes profundas tanto em **Portugal** quanto no **Brasil**, refletindo uma ligação sólida entre os dois países.  
Em constante crescimento, a DBServices destaca-se por atender grandes empresas em Portugal, nos Estados Unidos e no Brasil, consolidando sua presença internacional e ampliando seu impacto no mercado global.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Engenheira de Plataforma Sênior com foco em Qualidade para integrar um time de plataforma de engenharia de qualidade no setor de varejo. Nessa posição, você vai habilitar os times de desenvolvimento a adotarem boas práticas de qualidade de software. Também será responsável pela arquitetura técnica do que entra no caminho crítico de execução de testes, garantindo que a experiência do desenvolvedor tenha a menor fricção possível.

  

**Atividades**

* Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de testes com base na pirâmide de testes, prevenindo e corrigindo a inversão da pirâmide
* Decidir o que entra no caminho crítico de execução, como suítes de PR, pipelines e quality gates
* Construir e manter a automação de testes para aplicações web, mobile e desktop de loja, incluindo simuladores de periféricos e a estratégia de device farm
* Desenhar e manter pipelines de teste com suítes de PR, quarentena de testes flaky, seleção de testes orientada a risco e testes sintéticos em produção (shift-right)
* Desenhar e manter bibliotecas de teste compartilhadas entre os times
* Definir estratégias de dados de teste e virtualização de serviços em conformidade com a RGPD (GDPR) e com os requisitos de dados de cartão
* Governar o uso de GenAI no fluxo de desenvolvimento e testes, e testar sistemas baseados em IA
* Conduzir a qualidade não funcional: segurança, privacidade, performance, resiliência e acessibilidade
* Habilitar e orientar os times em práticas de qualidade, definindo padrões e compartilhando conhecimento

jobs.title: Sr Kubernetes Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  

We are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. We get up every day, roll up our sleeves and build a better world - together. At Ford, we’re all a part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to change the way the world moves?

Join a team building an enterprise-grade private cloud platform from the ground up, treating on-premise and hybrid infrastructure as a scalable, living software product rather than a set of manually operated systems. This role goes beyond configuring platforms — the candidate will help build them, developing and scaling OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters end-to-end through GitOps practices.

The ideal candidate has a strong engineering (not purely operational) mindset, with hands-on coding and automation skills. This includes experience with GitOps tools (Argo CD, Github Actions, Tekton), Infrastructure as Code (YAML/IaC), Ansible playbooks, and proficiency in Go and/or Python (or a similar object-oriented systems language), along with API development experience. A deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, its components, and Operators is essential. The role blends platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and developer enablement, applying software engineering best practices to reliability, scalability, and self-service capabilities for application teams.

**What you'll do...**

* Design, build, architect, and maintain OpenShift/Kubernetes platforms for on-premise, bare-metal, and hybrid cloud environments, including virtualized (OpenShift Virtualization/OSV) and containerized workloads.
* Develop and support custom Kubernetes/OpenShift Operators, APIs, and developer tooling to enable seamless, self-service platform capabilities for application teams.
* Write clean, testable, and robust infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Go, Python, and Ansible to eliminate manual toil and drive the private cloud transformation.
* Implement and manage GitOps-based CI/CD deployment pipelines using tools such as Argo CD, Tekton (OpenShift Pipelines), GitHub, Helm, Kustomize, and related build tools.
* Enhance platform reliability through monitoring, alerting, observability, and automated recovery/self-healing mechanisms, applying a software-driven SRE approach (including auto-scaling and disaster recovery automation).
* Build and integrate observability solutions and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace/AppDynamics, and logging platforms (ELK/Splunk).
* Support distributed systems, microservices, API gateways, and service mesh (e.g., Istio) architectures, including secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) and Zero-Trust security models.
* Explore and integrate emerging capabilities such as AI/ML pipelines (e.g., Vertex AI) and chaos engineering into private cloud operations.
* Collaborate closely with architects and application teams to improve platform usability, share ideas, and tackle platform constraints.
* Mentor team members (junior and senior developers), champion coding standards, and promote best practices in software craftsmanship, platform engineering, and GitOps workflows.

**You'll have...**

* 6+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or DevSecOps, with a strong automation and software development skillset (engineering mindset, not purely operational).
  + Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes/OpenShift (OCP) platform administration and internals — cluster builds, upgrades, and integrations — implemented entirely through code, scripts, and automation (not manual/GUI-driven).
  + Strong object-oriented programming background with demonstrated development skills in Go and/or Python (or a similar systems language); comfortable as a hands-on developer/individual contributor.
  + Practical experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling (e.g., GitHub, Argo CD/OpenShift GitOps, Tekton/OpenShift Pipelines).
  + Hands-on experience with API development, integration, and an "API-first" mindset.
  + Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation.
  + Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native design principles.
  + Experience with Kubernetes Operators and custom controllers.

**Even better, you may have...**

* Experience with OpenShift internals such as Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM), MachineConfig, Multus CNI, Trident, Ceph, and OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF).
* Experience with OpenShift Virtualization for running mixed container and VM workloads.
* Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) and API gateways.
* Experience with observability and analytics tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics), including writing custom exporters/dashboards.
* Experience with storage solutions (Ceph, ODF) and secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault).
* Exposure to hybrid cloud or private cloud environments, bare-metal/VMware infrastructure, and Zero-Trust security models.
* Familiarity with additional developer pipeline tools such as SonarQube, Maven, Polyrepo/Monorepo workflows.
* Interest or experience integrating AI/ML platforms (e.g., Vertex AI) and chaos engineering into infrastructure operations.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Backend Engineer - Remote**  
  
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.  
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  
  
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer  
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)  
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2  
Salary Range: $100,000–$175,000 Annually  
Experience Required: 10+ years  
  
**Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.**  
  
**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement large-scale distributed backend systems using Java, Go, Scala, or similar high-performance languages.
* Architect data partitioning, replication, and consistency strategies appropriate to each workload’s requirements.
* Build resilient APIs and event-driven services with strong observability, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
* Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost, using profiling, benchmarking, and load testing.
* Lead detailed architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and trade-off analyses.
* Implement robust failure-handling patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and saga workflows.
* Design and operate data stores at scale, including relational, key-value, document, and search engines.
* Build comprehensive observability into services with structured logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
* Drive incident response and post-incident learning for critical backend services.
* Mentor mid-level engineers and lead by example in code quality, design, and operational rigor.
* Partner with SRE and platform teams to drive reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.
* Contribute to long-term architecture and platform strategy, helping shape multi-year technical roadmaps and ensuring near-term execution remains aligned with the broader engineering direction.
* Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

  
Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Ten or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Scala, or similar.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consensus, replication, and CAP trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience with high-throughput message systems such as Kafka.
* Experience operating systems at scale, including capacity planning and performance tuning.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentorship skills.

  
How to Apply  
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to venkat.r@bvteck.com or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Card Loan Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Card Loan Platform team builds the high-throughput decision engine at the heart of Affirm's card products. Unlike traditional cards, every pay-later transaction is backed by its own unique loan, and our system is the "invisible piping" that makes this complex model work at scale. Every swipe triggers our platform to solve a hard problem in milliseconds: matching messy, fragmented payment network data to the correct loan to drive real-time approvals, origination, and refunds.

As Affirm experiences explosive growth, our team's contributions are a key enabler. This isn't just another backend role; you'll be building the "financial brain" for our flagship card products, with your work on the critical path for every single swipe. We're tackling a unique, high-stakes distributed systems challenge that demands exceptional correctness and massive scale. You will partner closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to design and build the future of our industry-leading money movement platform.

If you are passionate about making foundational design decisions and building a beloved, lasting financial brand—come join us. It's going to be an amazing ride!

**What you'll do**

* Drive technical strategy by leading the planning, prioritization, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with product, technical, and business goals.
* Lead the end-to-end system design and development of large-scale, high-availability services. This includes building robust APIs and data models for our micro-service and event-driven architectures.
* Collaborate across functions with partners in Product, Analytics, Design, Legal, and Accounting and to define requirements and execute our card loan attribution and lifecycle strategy.
* Ensure system health and performance by analyzing and troubleshooting complex technical issues, optimizing existing code, and driving solutions that focus on long-term robustness and scalability.
* Mentor and grow the team by guiding junior engineers, leading technical discussions and design reviews, and championing best practices through code review.

**What we look for**

* 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.
* Motivated leader, inspiring team growth and fostering a culture of continuous learning
* Excellent communicator, adept at sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a creative and solution-oriented mindset.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL), web frameworks, and RESTful API development.

**USA Sapphire base pay range (all other U.S. states):** $173,000 - $233,000

*#LI-Remote*

**Remote-first with flexibility built in**

Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. Description

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior C++ Software Engineer to join our Network Management Service (NMS) team, focused on building and evolving the cross-platform delegate component that powers device discovery and network insight across distributed environments. The component operates close to the network and interacts directly with customer devices using a variety of network management and system protocols. You will design and implement software that performs device discovery, collects and processes network data, executes monitoring workflows, and communicates with network infrastructure at scale.

This is a systems-oriented C++ role. You will work with asynchronous operations, concurrent communication, platform-specific APIs, and performance-sensitive code running on both Windows and Linux. The codebase is primarily C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where required.

Collaborating closely with backend, UI, QA and product teams, you will help shape reliable, scalable solutions that deliver deep visibility into customer networks. If you are an experienced C++ engineer who enjoys working on systems-level challenges, network protocols, distributed architectures, and performance-critical applications, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a rapidly growing platform.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

Onsite interviews may be required for this role.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

Cross-Platform Development: Build and maintain software for Windows and Linux using C++ and Qt, with native platform-specific implementations where appropriate. This may involve Windows APIs, POSIX, networking APIs, and other OS-specific facilities.
Network Discovery and Monitoring: Design and implement features for discovering network devices, collecting device and interface information, and monitoring network health.
Network Protocols: Work with protocols such as SNMP, SSH, ICMP, WMI, and other network and device management protocols. Implement and troubleshoot protocol interactions and handle the differences between vendors and devices.
Systems Programming: Develop high-performance, concurrent C++ software that runs close to the network and communicates with potentially thousands of devices.

At Ro, we believe that when people achieve their health goals, they can achieve their life goals. The highest-leverage way to move society forward is to give people their health, and the current healthcare system isn’t built to do that. It was built to bill, not to serve patients.

We’re building a new system. One where the patient is in control. One designed from scratch for the digital age.

At Ro, technology isn’t just a function… It's core to how we deliver care .
We’ve built a vertically integrated healthcare platform that connects telehealth, diagnostics, pharmacy, and logistics into a seamless, end-to-end experience for millions of patients.

…and we’re just getting started.

Solve complex, high-concurrency problems across a full-stack platform

Own systems end-to-end, from architecture to production performance

Build the systems and foundations that enable the team to move faster over time, creating reusable capabilities that make it easier to rapidly test, iterate on, and scale new patient and growth experiences as Ro continues to evolve the future of healthcare.

Deep backend and systems design expertise, with the ability to reason across services, APIs, data flows, dependencies, and architectural boundaries.

About Nametag

Nametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.

Deepfakes, social engineering, and stolen credentials have made "who is actually on the other side of this request?" a critical infrastructure problem. We are building the identity verification and account protection layer companies use to answer that question quickly, securely, and with less friction for real users.

The Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the integrations that put Nametag inside the systems our customers already use.

Nametag is rarely the application someone opens. It's the identity check that happens inside a helpdesk ticket, an HR onboarding flow, or a Slack message from someone claiming to be the CFO. Our reach is determined by how well we embed into Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, ICIMS, UKG, and the long tail behind them — and that embedding is engineering work.

This is a full stack role with an unusual center of gravity. You'll write backend services and APIs on our side, configuration and setup experiences in our console, and the connector code that talks to a dozen platforms that each made different decisions about authentication, extensibility, and what a webhook means. You'll join a dedicated team whose purpose is expanding Nametag into new systems and new use cases.

What makes this work interesting is that you're building into environments you don't control and can't change. Every target platform has its own auth model, its own rate limits, its own review process, and its own idea of how much UI you're allowed. Workday's extensibility surface is narrow and governed. Slack gives you modals and Block Kit, which were not designed for identity verification. ServiceNow gives you enough rope to break a customer's upgrade path. Designing something that is secure, usable, and actually buildable inside those limits — and that keeps working when the vendor ships a change you didn't ask for — is the core of the job.

The breadth is real. You'll be reading someone else's API documentation most weeks, and debugging behavior that documentation doesn't describe. Engineers who like going deep on one system for a year will be unhappy here. Engineers who like landing in an unfamiliar platform and having it figured out by Thursday will do well.

You'll work closely with the product manager for integrations, who owns how each integration should work, and you'll have real influence over that design because you're the one who knows what the platform will actually permit.

What You'll Do

Build integrations end to end

Design and build connectors into third-party enterprise platforms: authentication, data flow, event handling, and the verification experience inside the host application.

Build the Nametag-side APIs, services, and webhooks each integration depends on.

Build the console configuration and setup experience customers use to install and operate the integration.

Take integrations through marketplace and app review processes, including the requirements that gate a listing.

Work across unfamiliar platforms

Get productive fast in APIs and extensibility models you haven't seen before, and develop real expertise in the ones that matter most.

Implement against OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and whatever a given platform does instead of those.

Handle the operational reality of depending on other people's systems: rate limits, partial outages, breaking changes, and undocumented behavior.

Own reliability across the fleet

Operate what you build. Integrations fail in production in ways that are specific to one customer's configuration, and you'll be the one who figures out why.

Build the observability that makes a broken integration visible to us before it's visible to the customer.

Design for versioning and backwards compatibility. Customers do not upgrade on your schedule.

Make each one faster than the last

Factor shared infrastructure out of individual connectors so common patterns stop being rebuilt.

Contribute to the tooling, scaffolding, and templates that shorten time to first working integration.

Document how each integration works well enough that support and solutions engineers can operate without you.

What We're Looking For

Work authorization required: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship.

You do not need to match every bullet. We care most about breadth, pragmatism, and comfort working against systems you don't control.

4+ years building and operating production software, including backend services and APIs.
Demonstrated experience integrating with third-party APIs in production — not a one-off script, but something you owned and kept running.
Strong backend skills in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or similar, plus enough frontend ability to build configuration and setup UI in React or a comparable framework.
Working knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, webhooks, and the failure modes each brings.
Relational database experience, PostgreSQL preferred.
Cloud experience, AWS preferred.
The temperament for integration work: patience with other people's documentation, and the instinct to verify rather than trust it.
Clear communication and good judgment in a remote, cross-functional team.

Bonus Points

Hands-on experience with Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, Entra, ICIMS, or UKG extensibility specifically.
Experience shipping an app through a marketplace or app review process.
Experience with identity, authentication, account recovery, fraud prevention, or compliance-heavy products.
Experience building an integration platform or connector framework rather than individual integrations.
Experience in a solutions engineering, professional services, or customer-facing engineering role.

What We Value

High ownership.
You see what needs doing and do it.
Technical judgment.
You make systems simpler, safer, and easier to operate.
Speed with care.
We move quickly because attackers move quickly, but we do not cut corners on trust or security.
Kindness and integrity.
Trust starts with how we work with each other.

Compensation

Nametag is a founding member of the Open Imperative and is committed to pay equity in technology. Final compensation is based on role, level, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter or hiring manager can share more during the process.

Culture and Benefits

Nametag is a remote-first team with regular in-person time to stay connected.

Remote-first, US-based team

Flexible schedules
Meaningful equity ownership

jobs.title: AgentCore Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

We’re hiring AgentCore Platform Engineers to build the agent-facing layer of the platform. That covers how agents run, remember and work together, and how they safely reach the internal systems the business already runs on. Each engineer will have a main focus in one of the two areas below and work closely across both. What you build becomes the template other teams copy, so quality and clarity matter as much as speed. This is a named-team engagement, so the person we propose is the person who starts.

We know production experience with Bedrock AgentCore is rare. We care more about strong AWS fundamentals and real hands-on work with agent frameworks than about whether you’ve used AgentCore by name. If that’s you, please apply.

FOCUS AREAS

Agent Runtime & Orchestration: Build runtime patterns, memory strategies, orchestration and multi-agent handoffs, and the reference implementations other teams copy.
Gateway, Tools & Integrations: Turn internal APIs, Lambdas and legacy systems into governed tools through AgentCore Gateway, including MCP server development.

Role Responsibilities

Runtime Patterns: Define how agents are structured, packaged and run on AgentCore Runtime, including sessions, state, error handling and timeouts.
Memory Strategies: Design short-term and long-term memory patterns using AgentCore Memory, and guide teams on when to use which.
Orchestration and Multi-Agent Handoffs: Build patterns for planning, tool use, supervisor/worker setups and handoffs between agents, with clear boundaries and fallbacks.
Tool Onboarding: Expose internal REST APIs, Lambda functions and legacy services as agent tools through AgentCore Gateway, using OpenAPI specs and Lambda targets.
MCP Server Development: Design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for systems that need custom integration, with clean tool definitions and schemas.
Governance and Access: Set up authentication and authorization for agents and tools (AgentCore Identity, OAuth, IAM) so agents only reach what they’re allowed to.
Legacy Integration: Work with system owners to wrap older or on-premises systems safely, handling rate limits, data mapping and error cases.
Reference Implementations and Standards: Build production-quality reference agents, starter kits and a repeatable process for adding, versioning and reviewing tools.
Evaluation and Guardrails: Build in evaluation, Bedrock Guardrails, contract tests and safety checks so agents and tools behave predictably before going live.
Enablement: Run walkthroughs, write docs and support the teams onboarding to the platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).
Hands-on experience building LLM agents with at least one agent framework (e.g., Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex).
Practical experience with LLM tool/function calling and handling model output.
Strong AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, containers, DynamoDB/S3, VPC connectivity and Secrets Manager.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and OpenAPI specs, and auth patterns such as OAuth 2.0 and OIDC.
Understanding of agent memory, retrieval (RAG) and context management trade-offs.
Deep hands-on strength in at least one of the two focus areas, and working knowledge of the other.
Clean, well-tested code that other engineers will read and reuse.
Clear communication and comfortable teaching patterns to other teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity). A strong plus, but not required.
Experience building or running MCP servers in a real environment.
Experience with multi-agent systems in production, including observability and failure handling.
Experience integrating with enterprise or legacy systems, or with API management platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong).
Experience with LLM evaluation tools and approaches.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry with data access controls.

Who You Are

You’ve built agents that actually work, and you know where they tend to break
You care about patterns other people can copy, not just clever one-offs
You think about security and access control before anything goes live
You pick up new AWS services quickly and learn by building
You’re honest about what agents can and can’t do today
You work well inside a client team and enjoy helping other engineers succeed
You have prior experience in consulting
Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Referment is working with a global investment and technology organisation to hire a lead-level Infrastructure Software Engineer for an application engineering team. You’ll build resilient internal platforms and services that improve software delivery and developer effectiveness across a technically demanding organisation.

The role combines hands-on distributed-systems engineering with technical architecture, product thinking and close collaboration. You’ll translate the needs of developers and infrastructure specialists into services that are reliable, usable and able to operate at significant scale.

The Role

Own infrastructure products and services that improve developer productivity.
Lead large technical projects from initial problem definition through design, delivery and operation.
Act as a senior technical architect for the wider application engineering team.
Partner with developers, application engineers and infrastructure specialists to understand user needs.
Shape product direction while making detailed engineering decisions and building production solutions.

What We're Looking For

At least seven years of direct experience designing, building and scaling large distributed systems.
Hands-on experience building within the Kubernetes ecosystem.
A track record of delivering complex developer-facing or user-facing products.
Strong programming across one or more relevant languages such as Python, Go or Rust.
A computer science or related technical degree.
Excellent communication, self-management and stakeholder skills, with a service-oriented approach.

Desirable Experience

Linux and networking fundamentals.
Hands-on work with on-premises infrastructure.

This could suit a senior or staff software engineer, platform engineer or developer-infrastructure specialist who wants architectural responsibility without leaving hands-on delivery.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer II
jobs.description:

In this role, you will work with professionals who are reimagining and reengineering business-critical operations and processes. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, launch new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

Assist development teams in delivering technical solutions using software development life cycle methodologies, including Scrum and Agile
Design, develop, and enhance software systems and custom components using modern development tools and frameworks
Analyze user requirements, system flows, data usage, and performance standards to define technical designs and identify problem areas
Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and develop and execute test procedures for software components
Plan, track, and manage deliverables across short-term sprints and long-term software deployments

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models- traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client's needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Management Information Systems
3+ years of full-stack software development experience
3+ years of experience with Modern Full Stack languages (Java, Python, React, Angular, etc.)
Experience orchestrating in cloud and/or serverless environments
Experience with Relational and Non-relational DBs (Postgres, SQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.)

Experience with Gen AI, Agentic AI, ML/NLP environments and tools

jobs.title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Python/React Sr
jobs.description:
**O que procuramos?**

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor FullStack que integrar nosso time de tecnologia, participando do desenvolvimento de soluções digitais escaláveis, modernas e de alta qualidade. Buscamos alguém com perfil colaborativo, iniciativa e interesse em resolver desafios técnicos, aprimorar soluções e acompanhar as tendências do mercado de tecnologia.

Você atuará em diferentes etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, desde a definição técnica e implementação até os testes, implantação e evolução contínua das aplicações.

**Atribuições principais:**

* Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações Full Stack, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software.
* Construir serviços e regras de negócio no Back-End utilizando Python e frameworks relacionados.
* Desenvolver interfaces responsivas e intuitivas utilizando tecnologias modernas de Front-End.
* Colaborar com Product Owners no entendimento e refinamento de requisitos, definição de critérios de aceite e evolução dos produtos.
* Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar soluções de qualidade.
* Desenvolver e executar testes unitários, de integração, API e testes funcionais automatizados.
* Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de revisões, refatorações e aplicação de padrões de desenvolvimento.
* Participar de discussões sobre arquitetura e decisões técnicas.
* Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e atuar na otimização de performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das aplicações.
* Apoiar práticas de CI/CD e DevOps, contribuindo para a automação e entrega contínua.
* Identificar riscos técnicos e propor soluções para aprimorar produtos e processos.

**Requisitos:**

* Inglês avançado;
* Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack, utilizando **Python** no Back-End e frameworks de Front-End como **React ou Vue.js;**
* Conhecimento em frameworks Back-End como **Django, FastAPI ou Flask;**
* Experiência no desenvolvimento e integração de **APIs RESTfu**l e na construção de aplicações escaláveis;
* Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e **NoSQL,** como **MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB e Couchbase;**
* Domínio de conceitos de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO), princípios SOLID, Design Patterns e boas práticas de Clean Code.
* Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes **(TDD)** e implementação de testes unitários, de integração, API e automatizados End-to-End.

**Diferenciais:**

* Conhecimento em práticas e ferramentas de **CI/CD** e **DevOps.**
* Experiência com **Infrastructure as Code (IaC**), automação e provisionamento de infraestrutura.
* Conhecimento em tecnologias de conteinerização, como **Docker e Kubernetes**.
* Experiência com plataformas de cloud, especialmente **Google Cloud Platform (GCP**).

**Localidade da posição: 100% remota**

**Quem é a Insi?**

Somos uma consultoria especializada em evolução digital. Mas, acima de tudo, somos uma empresa de gente. Gente que ouve antes de propor. Que vai ao essencial antes de apresentar solução. Que mede sucesso pelo que mudou de verdade, não pelo que foi implementado.

Com mais de três décadas de história e presença global, acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação começa dentro: dentro das pessoas, das equipes, das organizações — e é essa convicção que orienta cada escolha que fazemos, cada projeto que entregamos, cada pessoa que desenvolvemos.

**Por que construir sua carreira na Insi?**

Porque aqui você pensa, decide e cria junto. Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente onde os Insiders têm espaço para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de projetos desafiadores, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo.

Somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e estamos entre os 10 melhores empregadores do Brasil segundo a revista TIME.

**Quais são nossos valores?**

* Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
* Pensamos e agimos como donos
* Temos gana por performance
* Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
* Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
* Atuamos com criatividade e inovação

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, **#VemSerInsi!**

jobs.title: [1242] Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Senior (Híbrido - Manaus)
jobs.description:
**Quem estamos buscando?**
--------------------------

Estamos buscando um(a) **Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior** para atuar em projetos de desenvolvimento de software, utilizando metodologias ágeis, voltados para uma empresa do segmento de produção de bens eletroeletrônicos e de informática.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento Full Stack, integração de soluções de Machine Learning e capacidade de atuar na definição de arquiteturas, desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis e colaboração técnica com equipes multidisciplinares.

**Como será o dia a dia?**
--------------------------

* **Desenvolvimento Full Stack:** Projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações web escaláveis, eficientes e de alta qualidade, utilizando tecnologias modernas de front-end e back-end.
* **Arquitetura e decisões técnicas:** Contribuir para a definição de arquiteturas, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo manutenibilidade, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções.
* **Integração de Machine Learning:** Desenvolver e integrar modelos preditivos em sistemas, trabalhando em parceria com cientistas de dados e engenheiros para viabilizar a implantação e o processamento eficiente de modelos.
* **Desenvolvimento de interfaces:** Criar interfaces intuitivas, responsivas e acessíveis, colaborando com designers e equipes de produto para garantir uma boa experiência do usuário.
* **Qualidade e testes:** Implementar estratégias de testes, revisar código e identificar oportunidades de melhoria na qualidade, performance e confiabilidade das aplicações.
* **Colaboração técnica:** Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, cientistas de dados, engenheiros e stakeholders para compreender requisitos, propor soluções e conduzir projetos com eficiência.
* **Mentoria e disseminação de conhecimento:** Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, compartilhando conhecimentos, boas práticas e orientando profissionais menos experientes.
* **Evolução tecnológica:** Avaliar e recomendar novas ferramentas, bibliotecas e frameworks para aprimorar os processos de desenvolvimento e os produtos da empresa.

**Quais as competências necessárias?**
--------------------------------------

* Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior, atuando em projetos de desenvolvimento web e soluções envolvendo Machine Learning.
* Domínio de tecnologias front-end, como HTML, CSS e JavaScript, e experiência com frameworks como React, Angular ou Vue.js.
* Sólida experiência em tecnologias back-end, como .NET/.NET Core, Node.js, Express, Django ou Flask.
* Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo MS SQL Server, e experiência com ORMs como Sequelize ou Mongoose.
* Conhecimento em Python e bibliotecas de Machine Learning, como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou scikit-learn.
* Experiência com arquitetura de software, desenvolvimento de APIs e integração entre sistemas.
* Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, testes automatizados e controle de versão com Git.
* Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na resolução de problemas complexos e na tomada de decisões técnicas.
* Experiência em metodologias ágeis e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

**O que seria um diferencial?**
-------------------------------

* Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas.
* Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas de DevOps.
* Experiência com serviços de cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
* Conhecimento em containerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
* Experiência com MLOps, implantação e monitoramento de modelos de Machine Learning em produção.
* Vivência em mentoria técnica e liderança de iniciativas de desenvolvimento.
* Compreensão dos princípios de design responsivo e desenvolvimento mobile-first.

**Quais são os benefícios de ser um Ventureiro ou Ventureira:**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Vale alimentação/refeição com valores acima da média de mercado;
* Plano médico e odontológico;

jobs.description:
Buscamos uma **Pessoa** **Desenvolvedora Full Stack Pleno** para fazer parte do nosso time de Engenharia, atuando na evolução de produtos digitais utilizados no contexto da saúde.

Você trabalhará em aplicações web de ponta a ponta, participando desde o entendimento do problema e das necessidades do negócio até o desenvolvimento, entrega e acompanhamento das soluções em produção.

Procuramos alguém com boa base técnica, autonomia para conduzir demandas do dia a dia e, principalmente, curiosidade para entender os problemas que estamos resolvendo. Mais do que apenas implementar tarefas, esperamos uma pessoa que participe das discussões, questione decisões quando necessário, proponha melhorias e tenha responsabilidade sobre aquilo que entrega.

Nosso ambiente valoriza colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, qualidade de código e o uso responsável de ferramentas de inteligência artificial como parte do processo de desenvolvimento.

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

* Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações web de ponta a ponta, atuando em **frontend e backend**.
* Construir e manter **APIs, integrações e interfaces web**.
* Participar de discussões técnicas e contribuir com decisões de implementação e arquitetura.
* Colaborar com Produto e demais áreas para entender problemas e transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
* Investigar problemas, corrigir bugs e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos sistemas.
* Garantir a qualidade, legibilidade e manutenção do código, participando também de revisões e testes.
* Acompanhar as próprias entregas até sua disponibilização e funcionamento adequado em produção.
* Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial como apoio ao desenvolvimento e à resolução de problemas.

  
**Requisitos e qualificações**  

### **Requisitos técnicos**

#### **Obrigatórios**

* Boa base de **JavaScript/TypeScript** e lógica de programação.
* Experiência com **Node.js** no desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços.
* Experiência com **React**, incluindo componentes, hooks, estados e integração com APIs.
* Familiaridade com frameworks de backend como **Express, Fastify ou similares**.
* Familiaridade com ferramentas e frameworks frontend como **Vite, Next.js ou similares**.
* Conhecimentos de **PostgreSQL** e bancos relacionais.
* Conhecimentos de **MongoDB** e modelagem orientada a documentos.
* Conhecimento de **Git** e fluxos de versionamento.
* Experiência no consumo e integração de **APIs REST**.
* Noções de **Docker**.
* **Familiaridade com AWS** e conceitos básicos de serviços em nuvem.
* Familiaridade e proatividade no uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento, como **Claude Code, Codex ou similares**.

#### **Desejáveis**

* Familiaridade com **Prisma ou Mongoose**.
* Conhecimentos de **CI/CD**, utilizando Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions ou similares.
* Entendimento básico de **arquitetura de microsserviços**.
* Experiência com **linters, formatação e testes unitários**.

### **O que esperamos de você**

* Autonomia e responsabilidade sobre as próprias entregas.
* Curiosidade para entender o negócio, o produto e o impacto das soluções na área da saúde.
* Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor melhorias.
* Atenção à qualidade, legibilidade e manutenção do código.
* Colaboração, abertura a feedback e disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e evoluir continuamente.

Esqueça o que você sabe sobre saúde. Na ISA Saúde, estamos construindo o futuro.

Acreditamos que o lugar mais seguro para o bem-estar e recuperação é o lar. Por isso, nosso propósito é ousado: fazer do lar o melhor hospital do Brasil. Usamos tecnologia de ponta para unir excelência clínica e atenção humanizada, revolucionando a saúde domiciliar no país.

Para cumprir essa missão, nossos valores guiam cada decisão e ação:

* DEDICAÇÃO PELO PACIENTE: Somos obcecados pela saúde e experiência do paciente e de sua família.

* COMPROMISSO COM A EXCELÊNCIA: Não aceitamos nada menos do que a excelência em tudo o que fazemos, porque a qualidade é inegociável quando se trata de vidas.

* NÃO EXISTE NÃO DÁ: Acreditamos que tudo é possível e estamos sempre buscando o melhor para o paciente e a companhia.

* COMUNICAÇÃO DIRETA: Falamos o que precisa ser dito com respeito e clareza, construindo a base da confiança.

* SEU PROBLEMA, MEU PROBLEMA: Cuidamos uns dos outros e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva, porque o sucesso de um é o sucesso de todos.

Quer fazer parte da transformação da saúde no Brasil? Conecte-se com a gente.

jobs.title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora BackEnd NodeJs Especialista I (Venda Direta)
jobs.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

  
  
**Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

Você atuará em uma squad de produto digital no contexto de Venda Direta, onde o desafio é desenvolver soluções de ponta que utilizam IA Generativa para apoiar nossa Força de Vendas e alavancar KPIs de negócio

* **Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura:** Atuar como ponto de apoio técnico , resolvendo problemas complexos, orientando a visão técnica e reduzindo o débito técnico.
* **Desenvolvimento Backend:** Construir soluções de backend focadas em performance, simplicidade, qualidade de código e experiência do usuário.
* **Inovação e PoCs:** Construir e testar Provas de Conceito (PoCs) aplicadas a tecnologias de GenAI.
* **Garantia de Qualidade:** Escrever testes automatizados (unitários e E2E), realizar Code Reviews e utilizar Pair Programming para manter padrões elevados de desenvolvimento.
* **Observabilidade e Monitoramento:** Acompanhar métricas de uso, erros e estabilidade do sistema, garantindo também o tagueamento preciso de dados.
* **Evolução de Sistemas:** Projetar melhorias, identificar oportunidades de otimização e manter a documentação técnica atualizada.
* **Protagonismo e Sentimento de Dono:** Participar ativamente das decisões técnicas e de produto, buscando constantemente soluções viáveis para os desafios de negócio.
* **Trabalho Colaborativo:** Atuar em sinergia com o time através de comunicação transparente e orientação para resolução de problemas.
* **Desenvolvimento com IA Generativa:** Criar soluções de ponta com GenAI voltadas para Venda Direta e alavancagem de KPIs de negócio.

 **Requisitos e qualificações**  

* **Desenvolvimento Backend:** Domínio prático Node.js.
* **Testes e Qualidade:** Prática com pirâmide completa de testes automatizados (Unitário, Integração e E2E) e análise de qualidade via Sonar.
* **Bancos de Dados:** Experiência com bancos relacionais (RDS) e não relacionais (DocumentDB, DynamoDB).
* **Nuvem e Mensageria (AWS):** Vivência na plataforma AWS (EC2, Secrets Manager, ElastiCache for Redis) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka, SQS).
* **DevOps e CI/CD:** Construção e manutenção de pipelines de Integração e Entrega Contínua via GitHub e GitHub Actions.
* **Observabilidade e Segurança:** Implementação de logs, métricas e tracing distribuído, além de boas práticas de código seguro e resolução de vulnerabilidades/incidentes.
* **Metodologia e Autonomia:** Atuação autônoma e colaborativa em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) em ambientes multi-linguagem.
* **Perfil e Visão Sistêmica:** Postura analítica, questionadora e pragmática para resolver problemas complexos com olhar arquitetural amplo.

**Diferenciais**

  

* Uso de assistentes de código (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) no fluxo de trabalho diário
* Experiência com integração de APIs de LLMs, plataformas de agentes ou motores de GenAI.
* Experiência frontend

  
  
  
**Informações adicionais**

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

Eterio Realities Inc. is a software company in Victoria, British Columbia, building augmented reality tools for industrial manufacturing. Our story began in 2010, out of challenges encountered during the construction of the Sparkling Hill Resort in Vernon, B.C.

Today we're a team of 30+ across Canada and India, and growing. We have built **FabStation**, an AR-enabled manufacturing execution system used by 200+ fabrication shops in 30+ countries. **FabStation** replaces paper and 2D drawings on the shop floor with AR-guided assembly, dimensional inspection, and production tracking, and it integrates with the workflows shops already run. Our mission is to empower steel fabricators with innovative augmented reality technology, revolutionizing the way they work.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for an **Intermediate Full Stack Developer** to join our Engineering team in developing new features and maintaining existing systems. You will design, implement, test, and deploy distributed software services across our Angular front end and .NET back end. Working closely with the UX team from Figma designs, you'll deliver customer-centric features, and you'll turn plain-language feature specifications into working software using AI-assisted development, with the review discipline to ship secure, high-quality code.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Maintain our services and components are well-defined, modular, secure, reliable, diagnosable and actively monitored.
* Design, implement, test and deploy distributed software services across the front end (Angular) and back end (.NET).
* Use Domain Driven Design to model the business domain to define boundaries of microservices.
* Take part in feature scoping with Product and the team, then interpret the resulting plain-language feature specification into a technical design, tasks and acceptance criteria. Raise gaps and ambiguities before building, not after.
* Implement features with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code or similar) and review every change for correctness, security and maintainability before opening a PR.
* Write unit and integration tests as part of every change, and take an active part in peer code review.
* Contribute to front-end and back-end architecture decisions.
* Collaborate with the UX team, working from Figma designs, to provide and deliver a customer-centric user experience to our customers.
* Collaborate with other developers and departments to create a positive work environment and technical solutions that add to the growth of the company.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
* Strong Angular experience (component architecture, RxJS, state management).
* Strong C# and .NET experience.
* Solid experience designing and implementing REST APIs.
* Solid experience working with SQL databases (schema design and queries).
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools day to day (e.g. Claude, Claude Code, or similar) and connecting AI tooling to IDE to speed up coding, testing, and code review.
* Experience turning written feature specifications into working software, including clarifying ambiguous or incomplete requirements.
* Code review experience: you catch defects in other people's code, including AI-generated code, not just your own.
* Working knowledge of secure coding practices: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization, input validation and secrets handling.
* Proactive and efficient approach to work.
* Strong written communication, including clear PR descriptions and technical write-ups.

jobs.title: Back End Developer
jobs.description:
**Back End Developer**
======================

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Here's the corporate drivel HR made us put at the top: Acro Commerce is looking for a Back End Developer to build, integrate, and maintain high-quality commerce solutions for our clients.

That's done. Now here's what we really want. Someone who codes like it's their native tongue, but can still talk comfortably with our crew and the odd client. You've shipped real things, you've debugged other people's messes, and you'd rather pick up a new stack than say "that's not my language." You care about writing code that the next developer won't curse you for.

You also know yourself. You can tell when you're stuck, and you ask for help before the deadline, not after. You can walk us through a bug that humbled you, and what you learned, without flinching. Low ego, high skills. That's the combo.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As a Back End Developer, you'll build and maintain the systems that help manufacturers, distributors, and brands sell online. Our client work spans a range of platforms and languages, and our developers flex between them. Right now, we're seeing a growing amount of .NET work, so if you've got .NET experience, we especially want to hear from you.

***Build & Deliver***

* Write high-quality, maintainable code that follows Acro Commerce standards and our production process
* Build new features, integrations, and full builds, as well as updates and revisions to existing sites
* Juggle multiple smaller tasks or larger builds with shifting priorities, and still hit your deadlines

***Problem Solving***

* Find and fix problems in code that might not be yours, where your only hint is a cryptic complaint from a client
* Provide accurate estimates for defects, builds, and new functionality, and stick to them
* Deliver efficient, practical solutions to work requests, issues, and defects

***Collaboration & Growth***

* Communicate clearly with Project Managers, Tech Leads, and clients about work requests, problems, and defects
* Act as a peer and mentor to other developers, while being comfortable asking for help yourself
* Pick up new languages and platforms as client work demands it

**What You Bring**
------------------

We're less concerned with degrees and more with what you can actually build. Formal education is NOT required; you just need to show us you can code.

* Solid hands-on back-end development experience, with work samples you can share
* Experience with .NET / C# is a strong asset
* Experience with some of what we work with day-to-day: PHP, Drupal, JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJS, React, NextJS, Shopify, WordPress, AWS, Docker, Lando, Kubernetes, Acumatica
* Know other languages? Tell us. If you're a badass Lisp hacker type, mention that too.
* Comfort in a Linux shell for day-to-day tasks, plus some understanding of Linux hosting (bonus points if you've set up your own server, even if nobody else cared)
* Source control experience (Git, GitHub, etc.)
* An excellent internet connection and hardware that can survive an hour-long conference call
* Fluency in English

If you've built something you're proud of and can show it, we want to see it.

**What We Bring**
-----------------

*All offers of employment with Acro Commerce are contingent on successfully completing a criminal background check.*

* **A team you'll actually like.** We take the work seriously and ourselves a lot less. Expect the occasional virtual happy hour, team competition, or reward for no particular reason. Fair warning: there are costumes. Check out our site and dissect how we do what we do.
* **Ownership and impact.** We aren't going to stick you in a corner with headphones on and call you "the IT department." Developers own this joint, and we get it. Your compensation package gets tailored to your location, experience, and your fit with our values, with hourly rates starting between $40 and $60 CAD.
* **Autonomy over your schedule.** Flexible start times, earned days off, and real remote work. Prefer to start at 8:00? 9:00? We'll work with you. Want every second Friday off? We've got a program for that. Work from your home office or from our Kelowna HQ- your call. *(Some client contracts require staff to be located in Canada, so most positions need you to be legally able to work here.)*
* **Professional development:** We might live and breathe *software* development, but we are also really passionate about our team's *personal* development, too. We love to learn and are always striving to be the best version of ourselves; whether it's training on the latest technology or learning how to become a better delegator, we will help you improve your skills and hit your goals.

All careers come with a 30-day no-questions-asked money-back guarantee. If you are in any way unsatisfied with your career, we will return you to the workforce at absolutely NO COST to you (minus shipping and handling).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
jobs.description:
**What We’re Building**

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

**Who We Are**

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

**How We Work**

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1. #LI-Remote

#### **Little more about the team:**

The LLM Observability (LLM O11y) team builds the foundational layer that makes AI workloads observable in Honeycomb. We define how AI systems are represented in telemetry (spans, traces, token usage, cost, eval signals, etc), and ensure that data from diverse ecosystems (e.g., LangChain, OpenLLMetry, Braintrust) is normalized into a consistent OpenTelemetry-based model.  
  
This team owns the infrastructure and data model that all downstream AI observability experiences rely on. Our work powers everything from cost analysis to anomaly detection. If you’re excited about defining and building the “source of truth” for how AI systems behave in production, this is the team for you.

#### **What you’ll do in the role:**

* **Design, build, and deliver backend systems and APIs.** You'll architect and implement APIs and backend services in Go, emphasizing clarity, maintainability, and backward compatibility. You'll think proactively about cost, scale, and risk — anticipating technical issues and exploring alternatives and tradeoffs thoroughly.
* **Build and maintain full-stack product features.** You'll contribute frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go) code to build robust product features, maintaining proficiency across the stack. You'll deliver impactful features that add value for our customers, our team, and Honeycomb overall.
* **Provide technical leadership.** You'll define patterns and operational guidelines that raise the bar for the team and beyond. Scale is building reliable AI systems for the world’s most important decisions. Our products help leading enterprises, governments, and frontier AI labs build, deploy, and evaluate AI systems at scale.

The Orchestration Platform is a core technology used across the company to run durable, reliable, and scalable workflows. It powers the complex, long-running processes behind Scale’s products - from data and model-evaluation pipelines to operational systems and customer-facing workflows.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve this foundational orchestration platform. You will design the primitives, services, and developer experience that enable teams across Scale to author, operate, observe, and safely scale distributed workflows. This is a high-leverage role for an engineer excited by distributed systems, reliability, and platform infrastructure used by many internal teams.

Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and operation of Scale’s core orchestration platform.
Build durable workflow infrastructure using technologies such as Temporal, Cadence, Kubernetes, and cloud-native systems.
Define platform primitives and APIs for scheduling, retries, state management, task execution, observability, and workflow lifecycle management.
Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and application teams to understand workflow needs and turn them into reusable platform capabilities.
Improve the reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience of services that run critical company workflows.
Establish technical standards and best practices for distributed workflow development, deployment, testing, and incident response.
Drive cross-functional technical decisions and communicate platform direction clearly to engineers and stakeholders.
